title: Challenge and Prior Knowledge Zone Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Predict whether a student is bored, engaged, in productive struggle, or overwhelmed from the gap between task challenge and prior knowledge, then explore the model.

learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish whether a student is bored, engaged, in productive struggle, or overwhelmed by examining the gap between a task's challenge and the student's prior knowledge and whether support is available, correctly classifying at least five of six scenarios.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge, student boredom, student engagement, productive struggle, and the four states of the challenge-minus-knowledge gap, from Chapter 2.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict before the reveal, then explore the model
keyQuestions: What is the gap between the task challenge and the student's prior knowledge?
Does support change the state for this gap?
commonMisconceptions: A bored student is always lazy
Struggle always means the task is too hard
Making a task easier is always the right response to a struggling student
assessmentOpportunities: A task at level 5 for a student at level 7: what state?
Does struggle always mean the task is too hard?
Is making the task easier the only fix for a gap of 4?

controls.name: Four state buttons
controls.description: Choose Bored, Engaged, Productive struggle, or Overwhelmed for the current scenario.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Shows or hides the definition of each state.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: Moves to the next scenario after feedback.

controls.name: Explore the model
controls.description: On the results screen, opens the map with the sliders and the support checkbox.

controls.name: Task challenge and Prior knowledge sliders
controls.description: In explore mode, set each value from 1 to 10.

controls.name: Support available
controls.description: In explore mode, turns the hint ladder on or off.
